subjects: The existing 32 settled ds-pro-v1 placement games from ladder/ds-pro-v1-placement.json only. No map, seat, outcome or phase exclusions. Replay full opening information is permitted only to the evaluator. Actual public carbon and observed roster history only for own actor, with historical own commands committed at each step.
test_order: First compare native physical transition to the official successor given exactly the same full board, actions, rules and order. Grade exact/near wallet or roster/ownership separately from ID renaming; compare full-map error independently of masked inputs. Second count the true measurement extent: base and canonical public actor use estimated carbon plus its known/unknown mask, current native search uses an all-one mask. Stratify per t0..49,50..149,150..249,250..298 and per map. Counterfactual deterministic world samples and state uncertainty are distinct. A mask discrepancy is not leakage. Third audit natural economic extinction and exact terminal rewards vs native search rule using the official interpreter. Do not infer frequency of extinct hypothetical search nodes from ordinary game endpoints.
deployable_candidate: Choose a single verified source-level economic or information-state correction from 7cf5 compatible with local native working limits, based on alignment, not match scores. For a belief correction, test it against evaluator-only truth and show a change in pure inference and native issued decisions via old public roots without deploying or opening matches. No external worker code or imported examiner at runtime.
public_probes: Predeclared chronological placement registry cards 0 through 3, candidate seat only, t=5,14,34,70. Restore own public observation history with real previous own order; no true carbon, real simultaneous enemy order or future action as input. Deterministic common sampling for attribution only, repeated unchanged-parent and corrected actions using native .58 seconds. Report matched width/depth/roll count separately, no attrition to remove unfavorable cases. A diagnosed issue may have zero reliable changes.
